 Christian Braun quiet in loss Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Nuggets Correspondent | Tue, Nov 17th 2026, 8:41am EST 
 Christian Braun scored ten points (4-7 FG, 2-4 3PT) and logged two steals in Monday night's 117-105 loss to the Phoenix Suns. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Braun was quiet on Monday night. He saw 33 minutes of action, but he was only able to rack up ten points in that time, while not adding much in other areas of the game. He should play better than this in the near future, although it doesn't seem like he has an elite game-to-game ceiling at this point.
